resources.string: Free software under the MIT License.
CamGrid is free software under the MIT License. The apps contain the components below, each under its own license. Select one to read its license text.

Used as unmodified shared libraries. You may replace them with your own FFmpeg build; desktop/README.md in the CamGrid source explains how. Source: ffmpeg.org and github.com/bytedeco/javacpp-presets (the build scripts).
Chromium’s FFmpeg, built into webrtc-java’s native library for H.264 decoding. That library can be replaced as a whole. Source: Chromium’s third_party/ffmpeg at the WebRTC revision webrtc-java names.
Used unmodified. The complete CamGrid source is public, so you can rebuild the app against a modified VLCKit; docs/ios.md explains how. Source: code.videolan.org/videolan/VLCKit.
Dual licensed under Apache-2.0 and LGPL-2.1; used under Apache-2.0.
